definitions.explanation: A legal verdict declaring that a defendant is not guilty of the charges. The opposite of {有罪|ゆうざい} (guilty).

examples.japanese: {被告人|ひこくにん}は{無罪|むざい}となった。
examples.english: The defendant was found not guilty.

examples.japanese: {無罪|むざい}を{主張|しゅちょう}する。
{長|なが}い{裁判|さいばん}の{末|すえ}、{彼|かれ}はようやく{無罪|むざい}{判決|はんけつ}を{勝|か}ち{取|と}った。
examples.english: After a long trial, he finally won a not-guilty verdict.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal term primarily used in court and news reporting. The antonym is {有罪|ゆうざい} (guilty). Japanese courts deliver a {無罪|むざい}{判決|はんけつ} (not-guilty verdict) when the prosecution fails to prove guilt beyond a reasonable doubt.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無罪|むざい}{判決|はんけつ}: not-guilty verdict
- {無罪|むざい}を{主張|しゅちょう}する: to claim innocence, to plead not guilty
- {無罪|むざい}{放免|ほうめん}: acquittal and release
- {無罪|むざい}を{勝|か}ち{取|と}る: to win an acquittal
